Round 10 of 10: Autonomous Self-Healing Graph Engine, Executive Incident Reports, WebGL Canvas Acceleration & Quick Action HUD

### Objective:
Implement four state-of-the-art self-healing, executive reporting, GPU rendering, and quick-action navigation capabilities in GVUI:
1. Autonomous Self-Healing Graph Engine & Auto-Remediation Playbooks (`src/engine/selfHealing/`, `src/store/useSelfHealingStore.ts`)
2. Executive PDF/HTML Architecture & Incident Report Exporter (`src/components/ExecutiveReport/`, `src/engine/reporting/`)
3. WebGL GPU-Accelerated Canvas Rendering & Shader Layer (`src/engine/GraphCanvas/webgl/`, `src/store/useWebGLRendererStore.ts`)
4. Global Keyboard Command Palette & Quick Action HUD (`src/components/CommandPalette/`, `src/store/useCommandPaletteStore.ts`)

### Non-Negotiable Invariants:
- 100% tests passing across all new suites
- Zero TypeScript any annotations or casts
- Full Zustand store state management with reactive components
- Strict disjoint write scopes and deterministic gate validation
